conclusion: WP712 already contains the useful DDS-like semantics in a stricter F2-native form: explicit freshness_max_age_ns, clock-domain-aware monotonic time, source generation/sequence, bridge generation and permission provenance. Do not add DDS as a dependency or duplicate lifespan fields. Transport QoS may optimize dropping but cannot replace WP712 validation. Cross-clock UNALIGNED_CANDIDATE must remain non-current unless separately aligned/re-observed.
next_exact_gate: Deterministic replay/reconnect and cross-clock tests should falsify accidental promotion of UNALIGNED or stale retained events; no E5 Trigger4 handoff until measured evidence demonstrates a net architecture benefit.
